Floating app button and download bars

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Sina news ad slots, floating app button and download bars; blur or hide news pictures; hide AI banner, hot list, mini videos
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, sina.cn mobile home page (Chinese interface). Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): SAX ad slots 9 and native ad cards 3 (`.j_sax`, `.s_card_sp_da`), floating app button 1, download strip 1, footer download links 1, AI chat banner 1, news pictures 98, hot list 1, mini videos 1, top carousel 1. Selectors are Sina's own ids and class names; none depend on Chinese text.

NOT verified: article pages, channel pages, www.sina.com.cn desktop (a different layout), signed-in states, the original cookie rule (no banner appeared).
